welcome_lead.name: General Lead Welcome & Enquiry Confirmation
welcome_lead.subject: Willkommen, {{firstName}}! Your Journey to {{destinationCountry}} Begins with Harry Overseas
welcome_lead.preheader: Thank you for contacting Harry Overseas. We have received your inquiry #{{referenceId}}.
welcome_lead.title: Welcome to Harry Overseas, {{firstName}}!
welcome_lead.subtitle: Your Trusted Gateway to German Language & European Migration
welcome_lead.intro: Thank you for reaching out to Harry Overseas! We are excited to assist you with your plans for {{destinationCountry}}. Our overseas education and immigration specialists have received your request and will review your profile to prepare a customized guidance plan.

sections.title: Next Steps for Your Consultation
items: A dedicated counselor will contact you via {{consultationMethod}} within 24 hours.
We will review your qualification documents against German legal and visa requirements.
You will receive a step-by-step roadmap covering document attestation, language prep, and visa submission.

welcome_lead.footerNote: Have an urgent question? Reply directly to this email or call our direct helpline at +91 6302951891.

course_enrolment.name: German Language Academy Course Enrolment
course_enrolment.subject: Willkommen im Deutschkurs! {{courseName}} Enrolment Confirmation for {{firstName}}
course_enrolment.preheader: Congratulations {{firstName}}! Your seat for {{courseName}} at Harry Overseas German Language Academy is confirmed.
course_enrolment.title: Herzlich Willkommen, {{firstName}}!
course_enrolment.subtitle: German Language Academy & Goethe / ÖSD Exam Preparation
course_enrolment.intro: Congratulations on taking the first major step toward fluency in German! We are delighted to confirm your enrolment in our {{courseName}} program.

sections.title: What's Included in Your Course Package
items: Interactive live sessions covering Speaking, Listening, Reading, and Writing (A1/A2/B1).
Comprehensive digital study materials, Netzwerkarbeitsbuch PDFs, and audio tracks.
Regular weekly vocabulary quizzes and Goethe / ÖSD exam pattern simulation tests.
Free guidance for visa interview preparation and blocked account setup.

course_enrolment.footerNote: Our academic coordinator will reach out to share your classroom link and schedule before the first session.

sampleData.trainingMode: Live Interactive Online via Zoom / In-Person Anantapur

nurse_pathway_welcome.name: Germany Registered Nurse Pathway Welcome
nurse_pathway_welcome.subject: Pflegefachkraft in Deutschland! Germany Nurse Pathway Details for {{firstName}}
nurse_pathway_welcome.preheader: Step-by-step roadmap to working as a licensed registered nurse in German hospitals.
nurse_pathway_welcome.title: Your Nursing Career in Germany, {{firstName}}!
nurse_pathway_welcome.subtitle: Direct Hospital Placement & German Medical License Recognition
nurse_pathway_welcome.intro: Thank you for inquiring about our Germany Nurse Recruitment Pathway. German hospitals and healthcare networks are actively welcoming qualified nurses from India with competitive salaries, permanent residency pathways, and family reunification benefits.

fields.label: Language Prerequisite
fields.value: B1/B2 German Certification (Provided at Harry Overseas)

fields.label: Hospital Placement
fields.value: Free Direct Hospital Placement & Contract Support

sections.title: Document Checklist to Keep Ready
items: B.Sc Nursing Degree Certificate or GNM Diploma mark sheets (all semesters).
Valid State Nursing Council Registration Certificate.
Minimum 1-2 years clinical hospital experience certificates.
Valid Indian Passport with at least 2 years validity.

nurse_pathway_welcome.footerNote: Our dedicated healthcare desk handles document translation, Defizitbescheid application, and visa processing end-to-end.
